description_en: Queries the basic information about a ticket
description_zh: 调用GetOrderBaseInfo获取工单基本信息
name: GetOrderBaseInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the tenant ID, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

OrderBaseInfo.description_en: The basic information about the ticket

AttachmentKey.description_en: The Key of the ticket attachment. This information is returned only when an attachment is uploaded when a ticket is created
AttachmentKey.description_zh: 工单附件Key。仅当工单创建时上传了附件，才会返回此信息

CommitterId.description_en: The ID of the applicant. Note: The ID is different from the Alibaba Cloud account ID of the applicant
CommitterId.description_zh: 提交者ID，注意不是提交者的阿里云UID

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the ticket was created

LastModifyTime.description_en: The time when the ticket was last modified

OriginAttachmentName.description_en: The original file name of the ticket attachment. This information is returned only when an attachment is uploaded when a ticket is created
OriginAttachmentName.description_zh: 工单附件原始文件名。仅当工单创建时上传了附件，才会返回此信息

PluginType.description_en: The type of the ticket. For more information about the value of this parameter, see the request parameters of the [CreateOrder]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465865.html） operation
PluginType.description_zh: 工单类型。取值及说明可参考[CreateOrder]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465865.html）接口的相应入参说明

UserIds.description_en: The IDs of the operators that are related to the ticket

items.description_en: The ID of the operator that is related to the ticket

UserNicks.description_en: The nicknames of the operators that are related to the ticket

items.description_en: The nickname of the operator that is related to the ticket

StatusCode.description_en:
The status code of the ticket. Valid values:

new: The ticket is created.
toaudit: The ticket is being reviewed.
Approved: The ticket is approved.
reject: The ticket is rejected.
processing: The ticket is being executed.
success: The ticket is executed.
closed: The ticket is closed
StatusCode.description_zh:
工单状态码，取值如下：
new：新建
toaudit：审批中
approved：审批通过
reject：审批拒绝
processing：执行中
success：执行成功
closed：已关闭

WorkflowInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the approval process

WorkflowStatusDesc.description_en: The description of the approval process

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
